name: Berliner Wand
origin: Composite of Berlin wall and vehicle lettering photographed by Wiegel
place: Berlin vehicle and wall lettering; Eisfabrik Köpenicker Straße wayfinding
summary: A blend of recurring Berlin sign-painting letterforms, triggered by a wayfinding commission for the ruined ice factory on Köpenicker Straße. OpenType stylistic sets toggle the Berlin ß, a descending z and a hooked initial I.
